coreFunctions.revenueCollectionDesc: Gye sika a ɛyɛ aban dea nyinaa na hwɛ sɛ wɔkyerɛw ne akontaa yɛ wɔ MDA nyinaa mu.
coreFunctions.secureCustodyDesc: Hwɛ aban sika, nneɛma a edi mfasoɔ ne sika nkrataa nyinaa so yie.
coreFunctions.disbursementsDesc: Yɛ aban tua ka nyinaa a ɛka akatua, pɛnhyen, bosea, ne adetɔfoɔ akatua ho.
coreFunctions.accountEstablishmentDesc: Bue na di bank akontaa ma Ghana Aman wɔ Bank of Ghana ne bank a wɔapene so mu.
coreFunctions.bankingAuthorityDesc: Yɛn nko na yɛwɔ tumi wɔ aban bank nkitahodi nyinaa so.
coreFunctions.financialReportingDesc: Yɛ na de sika amanneɛbɔ a wɔaka abom wɔ abosome 3 akyi wɔ afe biara.
coreFunctions.accountingStandardsDesc: Yɛ na de akontaa nhyehyɛeɛ ne nkyerɛkyerɛmu di dwuma ma aban ahyehyɛdeɛ nyinaa.
coreFunctions.systemsDevelopmentDesc: Yɛ, hwɛ na yɛ sika nhyehyɛeɛ so sɛ GIFMIS, akatua nhyehyɛeɛ, ne intanɛt tua ka.
coreFunctions.revenueCollectionFull: Wɔnam wɔn adwumayɛfoɔ a wɔwɔ aban ahyehyɛdeɛ nyinaa mu, ne deɛ wɔboaboa sika ano no so yɛ.
coreFunctions.secureCustodyFull: Wɔne Ministry of Finance ne Bank of Ghana bom hwɛ sɛ aban sika nyinaa wɔ ahotɔ mu.
coreFunctions.disbursementsFull: Akatua a wɔtua bosome biara ma aban adwumayɛfoɔ, pɛnhyen bosea ne bosome biara pɛnhyen akatua ma wɔn a wɔakɔ pɛnhyen, ne sika a wɔde ma aban dwumadie ne nkɔsoɔ wɔ ɔman nyinaa mu.
coreFunctions.accountEstablishmentFull: Bue akontaa wɔ Bank of Ghana ne wɔn a wɔboa wɔn hɔ, sɛ wɔde bɛhyɛ aban ne ahoto sika.
coreFunctions.bankingAuthorityFull: Ɔno nko na ɔwɔ tumi sɛ ɔbɛbue bank akontaa ama aban ahyehyɛdeɛ biara wɔ ɔman nyinaa mu.
coreFunctions.financialReportingFull: Hwɛ so, yɛ, na kyerɛ sika amanneɛbɔ wɔ Ghana Consolidated Fund so bosome biara ne afe biara, ansaana abosome mmiɛnsa awiei wɔ sika afe biara akyi. Wɔde sika amanneɛbɔ a ɛho hia ma Auditor-General sɛ ɔbɛhwɛ mu na ɔde akɔma Parliament.
coreFunctions.accountingStandardsFull: Hwɛ sɛ aban ahyehyɛdeɛ nyinaa di akontaa nhyehyɛeɛ pɛ a ɛne IPSAS hyia so.
coreFunctions.systemsDevelopmentFull: Ma akontaa nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛyɛ papa nkɔsoɔ wɔ aban ahyehyɛdeɛ nyinaa mu wɔ teknoloji, adwene foforɔ, ne dijital nsakraeɛ mu.
coreFunctions.legalPara1: Saa tumi titire yi wɔ Ghana 1992 Ahyɛdeɛ mu na wɔakyerɛ mu pefee wɔ Public Financial Management Act, 2016 (Act 921) mu.
coreFunctions.legalPara2: PFM Act no maa CAGD tumi kɛseɛ wɔ sɛnea ɔhwɛ aban sika adetɔ nyinaa so na ɔhwɛ sɛ gyinabie pa wɔ mu.
coreFunctions.legalPara3: Wɔ saa mmara yi ase no, CAGD yɛ beaeɛ titire ma aban sika nhyehyɛeɛ nyinaa, na ɔne Ministry of Finance, Bank of Ghana, Ghana Revenue Authority, ne Auditor-General bom yɛ adwuma.

ourHistory.title: Yɛn Abakɔsɛm
ourHistory.description: Firi 'The Treasury' wɔ 1885 kɔsi sika nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛyɛ adeɛ kɛseɛ — mfeɛ 140 a yɛasom Ghana.
ourHistory.timelineDesc: Yɛhwɛ sɛnea Ghana sika nhyehyɛeɛ ahyehyɛdeɛ asakra
ourHistory.journeySummary: Mfeɛ 140 a yɛahwɛ Ghana sika so
ourHistory.journeySubtext: Firi abrokyire tumi ase sikaguadie kɔsi dijital ahyehyɛdeɛ a ewiase nyinaa hu
ourHistory.era1Event1: Abrokyire tumi no hyɛɛ 'The Treasury' aseɛ wɔ Gold Coast sɛ wɔde bɛhwɛ ɔman sika so.
ourHistory.era1Event2: The Treasury hwɛɛ abrokyire tumi aban sika gyeɛ ne akatua nyinaa so wɔ Gold Coast mu.
ourHistory.era1Event3: Sika nhyehyɛeɛ tumi trɛwee wɔ Gold Coast mu sɛnea abrokyire tumi no nyinii.
ourHistory.era2Event1: Wɔsesaa The Treasury din kɔɔ Accountant-General's Department, sɛnea ne akontaa ne sika nhyehyɛeɛ tumi atrɛw.
ourHistory.era2Event2: Wɔyɛɛ sika nhyehyɛeɛ foforɔ wɔ Wiase Ko a Ɛtɔ So Mmienu mu ne akyiri sɛ ahia no dɔɔso.
ourHistory.era2Event3: Nhyehyɛeɛ ma wo ho aban de sika nhyehyɛeɛ dwuma ne ahyehyɛdeɛ nsakraeɛ foforɔ baeɛ.
ourHistory.era3Event1: Ghana nyaa ne ho wɔ Ɔbɛnem da 6. Department no somm Republic of Ghana foforɔ no.
ourHistory.era3Event2: Wɔhyɛɛ aseɛ wɔ Civil Service Act 1960 (CA. 5) ase sɛ Civil Service Akontaa Kuo.
ourHistory.era3Event3: Aban dwumadie a ɛtrɛwee ntɛm hwehwɛɛ sɛ wɔhwɛ sika so yie na wɔbɔ ho akontaa.
ourHistory.era4Event1: Wɔsesaa din no kɔɔ Controller & Accountant-General's Department (CAGD), na ɛkyerɛɛ ne tumi a atrɛw wɔ sika hwɛsoɔ ne sika nhyehyɛeɛ mu.
ourHistory.era4Event2: Ɔman sika nsakraeɛ ne nhyehyɛeɛ foforɔ sesaa aban sika nhyehyɛeɛ wɔ Ghana mu.
ourHistory.era5Event1: Republic a Ɛtɔ So Ɛnan 1992 Ahyɛdeɛ de CAGD tumi hyɛɛ aban sika nhyehyɛeɛ mu.
ourHistory.era5Event2: Internal Audit Agency Act 2003 (Act 658) maa nhwehwɛmu ne hwɛsoɔ tumi.
ourHistory.era5Event3: Ghana penee sɛ ɔde accrual-based IPSAS bɛdi dwuma — gyinaeɛ kɛseɛ ma sika tew.
ourHistory.era6Event1: Public Financial Management Act, 2016 (Act 921) yɛɛ CAGD mmara nhyehyɛeɛ foforɔ.
ourHistory.era6Event2: Wɔsakraa kɔɔ Electronic Fund Transfers so — wɔyii nsa krataa tua ka nyinaa.
ourHistory.era6Event3: Controller & Accountant-General nyaa Governance and Civil Leader of the Year aboafoɔ.
ourHistory.era6Event4: Ghana yɛɛ ne ɔman nyinaa sika akontaa a ɛdi kan — ɛkaa amanaman sɛ UK, Canada, ne Australia ho.
ourHistory.era6Event5: Wɔyɛɛ TPRS foforɔ a ɛwɔ korɔno bɔneɛ ho tumi. MDA 703 na wɔkata so.
ourHistory.era6Event6: Wɔhuu adwumayɛfoɔ korɔno 533 na wɔyii wɔn firii aban akatua mu; wɔyii National Service korɔno din 14,027.
ourHistory.era6Event7: NIA-CAGD abom ma bere koro mu biometric akatua nhwehwɛmu wɔ Ghana Card so.

coreValues.title: Yɛn Suban Pa
coreValues.description: Nkyerɛkyerɛmu enum a ɛkyerɛ sɛnea yɛsom Ghana sika nhyehyɛeɛ.
coreValues.clickToLearn: Tia biribiara so na sua sɛnea yɛde di dwuma
coreValues.quote: Papayɛ nyɛ nimdeɛ. Ɛyɛ suban — na wɔ CAGD, ɛyɛ yɛn amammerɛ.
coreValues.fullDesc1: Yɛn nhyehyɛeɛ, nhyehyɛeɛ, ne dwumadie nyinaa a yɛde ma no, yɛde nea ɔde di dwuma no adwene yɛ — sɛ ɛyɛ aban ahyehyɛdeɛ a ɛretwɛn sika, aban somfoɔ a ɔrehwɛ ne e-payslip, anaasɛ pɛnhyenni a ɔrenya ne bosome akatua. Yɛde nea yɛsom no anigyeɛ na yɛsusu yɛn nkɔsoɔ.
coreValues.fullDesc2: Amantam ofisi 16 wɔ Ghana baabiara ne MDA 703+ a yɛkata so no, yɛhwɛ sɛ ɔman biara nni akyire. Yɛyɛ ntɛm bua afoforɔ hia sɛ wɔwɔ Accra anaasɛ mantam a ɛwɔ akyire paa.
coreValues.fullDesc3: Firi sɛ yɛhuu adwumayɛfoɔ korɔno 533 wɔ aban akatua nhyehyɛeɛ mu kɔsi sɛ yɛde IPSAS nhyehyɛeɛ 31 firi 36 mu adi dwuma no, nokorɛdie yɛ yɛn nneɛma nyinaa fapem. Yɛbɛyɛ nokorɛ wɔ yɛn nsɛm ne yɛn dwuma mu.
coreValues.fullDesc4: Yɛde sika bo yɛn nkurɔfoɔ mu wɔ Treasury Hour CPD, TRELAS, CAGD Welfare Scheme, ne nimdeɛ nkɔsoɔ nhyehyɛeɛ mu. Adwumayɛfoɔ a wɔwɔ ahoɔden na wɔatetee yɛ sika nhyehyɛeɛ papa engine.
coreValues.fullDesc5: Firi sɛ yɛsakraa kɔɔ intanɛt tua ka wɔ 2018 kɔsi sɛ yɛne National Identification Authority bom ama biometric akatua nhwehwɛmu wɔ 2024 no, yɛtwe yɛn ho firi deɛ wobɛtumi ayɛ wɔ aban sika mu. Adwene foforɔ nyɛ nhyɛsoɔ — ɛyɛ sɛnea yɛtena mu.

faqPage.title: Nsɛm a Wobisa Pii
faqPage.description: Nya mmuaeɛ ma nsɛm a wobisa pii fa CAGD dwumadie ne nhyehyɛeɛ ho.
faqPage.q1: Meyɛ dɛn na manya me akatua krataa a ɛwɔ intanɛt so (e-Payslip)?
faqPage.a1: Wobɛtumi anya wo e-Payslip wɔ CAGD e-Payslip wɛbsaet epayslip.cagd.gov.gh so. Ɛsɛ sɛ wowɔ wo adwumayɛfoɔ ID ne fon nɔma a woakyerɛw ansa na woatumi alogin.
faqPage.q2: Adɛn nti na me akatua akyɛ?
faqPage.a2: Akatua kyɛ betumi aba esiane nkrataa a enwie, nhwehwɛmu a ɛretwɛn, anaasɛ ɔhaw bi wɔ wo MDA akatua nkrataa mu. Ka kyerɛ wo mantam CAGD ofisi na wɔbɛboa wo.
faqPage.q3: Meyɛ dɛn na mebɔ akatua mfomsoɔ ho amanneɛ?
faqPage.a3: Di kan ka kyerɛ wo MDA akatua nkyekyɛmu. Sɛ wɔantumi ansi ano a, ka kyerɛ CAGD Akatua Nkyekyɛmu wɔ wo mantam ofisi mu ne nkrataa a ɛboa.
faqPage.q4: Meyɛ dɛn na mesesa me bank nsɛm ma akatua?
faqPage.a4: De abisadeɛ krataa fa wo MDA HR/Akatua nkyekyɛmu so ne krataa, ID a ɛyɛ papa, ne bank nsɛm foforɔ. Nsakraeɛ no bɛyɛ wɔ akatua bere 1-2 mu.
faqPage.a5: Ghana Integrated Financial Management Information System (GIFMIS) yɛ aban sika nhyehyɛeɛ nhyehyɛeɛ a wɔde di dwuma ma sika nhyehyɛeɛ yɛ, akatua, ne akontaa wɔ MDA nyinaa mu.
faqPage.q6: Meyɛ dɛn na menya GIFMIS kwan?
faqPage.a6: GIFMIS kwan no, wo MDA Sika Panin na ɔma. De abisadeɛ ne wo dwuma ne wo nkyerɛwsofoɔ panin peneɛ ma.
faqPage.q7: Sɛ GIFMIS adwo a, dɛn na menyɛ?
faqPage.a7: Ka kyerɛ CAGD ICT Nkyekyɛmu boa desk wɔ ict@cagd.gov.gh anaasɛ frɛ ICT boa fon no. Nhyehyɛeɛ a wɔahyɛ da no, wɔbɔ amanneɛ kan.
faqPage.q8: Me betumi atwe CAGD amanneɛbɔ wɔ he?
faqPage.a8: Amanneɛbɔ a ɛyɛ aban dea wɔ Amanneɛbɔ ne Nkrataa krataafa yi so. Wobɛtumi ahwehwɛ wɔ nkyekyɛmu ne afe so na woatwe PDF no tẹe.
faqPage.q9: Mpɛn ahe na wɔde sika amanneɛbɔ ma?
faqPage.a9: Afe amanneɛbɔ ba afe biara, na abosome mmiɛnsa sika nhyehyɛeɛ amanneɛbɔ ba abosome mmiɛnsa biara. Amanneɛbɔ soronko ba sɛnea ehia.
faqPage.a10: International Public Sector Accounting Standards (IPSAS) yɛ akontaa nhyehyɛeɛ a wɔde ma aban ahyehyɛdeɛ. Ghana resakra akɔ IPSAS so sɛnea tew ne nhyɛsoɔ bɛba sika amanneɛbɔ mu.
faqPage.q11: IPSAS nhyehyɛeɛ ahe na Ghana de adi dwuma?
faqPage.a11: Ghana de IPSAS nhyehyɛeɛ 31 firi 36 mu adi dwuma. Deɛ aka no 5 wɔ nkɔsoɔ ahorow mu. Hwɛ IPSAS Dwumadie krataafa no so ma nsɛm pii.
faqPage.a12: CAGD ofisi yɛ adwuma Ɛdwoda kɔsi Fiada, anɔpa 8:00 kɔsi anwummerɛ 5:00. Amantam ofisi nso di saa bere koro no so.
faqPage.q13: Meyɛ dɛn na medi me mantam CAGD ofisi nkitahodi?
faqPage.a13: Kɔ Di Yɛn Nkitahodi krataafa no so na tia wo mantam so na woahu fon nɔma, email, ne ofisi adirɛs.
faqPage.q14: CAGD gye asuafoɔ a wɔrepɛ adwumayɛ mu suahunu?
faqPage.a14: Aane, CAGD gye asuafoɔ a wɔrepɛ adwumayɛ mu suahunu ne national service adwumayɛfoɔ. De wo abisadeɛ krataa ne CV ma HR nkyekyɛmu wɔ ofisi panin hɔ.

ict.directoratesDesc: Nkyerɛwsofoɔ ofisi mmiɛnsa di Nkyekyɛmu no dwuma anim sɛ wɔde teknoloji a ɛwɔ ahotɔ bɛma.
ict.quote: Teknoloji yɛ afamu a ɛda aban dwuma pa ne nnipa dwumadie ntam.
ict.keyFunctionsDesc: Tumi titire a ɛkyerɛ ICTM Division dwuma wɔ CAGD dijital nsakraeɛ mu.
ict.dir1Desc: Ɔhwɛ ICT nneɛma nyinaa so a ɛka intanɛt, servers, data centres, ne ahotɔ nhyehyɛeɛ ho.
ict.dir2Desc: Ɔhwɛ ICT dwumadie, hwɛsoɔ, amanehunu nhyehyɛeɛ, ne boa desk so.
ict.dir3Desc: Ɔhwɛ nhyehyɛeɛ nyinaa, nhyehyɛeɛ a wɔaka abom, nsɛm nsusueɛ, ne teknoloji boa so.
ict.kf1Desc: Ma management adwene wɔ ICT foforɔ ne teknoloji nhyehyɛeɛ so.
ict.kf2Desc: ICT nneɛma ne intanɛt hwɛsoɔ ne nkɔsoɔ.
ict.kf3Desc: Hwɛ sɛ ICT ahotɔ, nhyehyɛeɛ di so, ne nsɛm hwɛsoɔ wɔ CAGD nhyehyɛeɛ nyinaa mu.
ict.kf4Desc: Yɛ ICT amanehunu ne dwumadie a ɛkɔ so nhyehyɛeɛ.
ict.kf5Desc: Hwɛ nhyehyɛeɛ so a ɛka GIFMIS, TPRS, ne e-Payslip ho.
ict.kf6Desc: De nsɛm nsusueɛ tumi boa gyinaeɛ a ɛgyina adanseɛ so.

payroll.heroDesc: Yɛyɛ nhyehyɛeɛ ne nkyerɛkyerɛmu ma aban akatua nhyehyɛeɛ.
payroll.purposeDesc: Government Payroll Management Division na ɛyɛ, ɛde di dwuma na ɛhwɛ nhyehyɛeɛ ne nkyerɛkyerɛmu so ma aban akatua a ɛka akatua ne pɛnhyen tua ka ne akatua twa so adetɔfoɔ ho.
payroll.additionalDesc: Yɛka akatua dwuma titire ho no, dwumadie foforɔ bi ka ho:
payroll.orgDesc: Tia nhyehyɛeɛ mfonini no na hwɛ mu yie
payroll.directoratesDesc: Tia nkyerɛwsofoɔ ofisi biara so na hwɛ ne nkyekyɛmu ne dwuma mu.
payroll.quote: Aban somfoɔ biara fata sɛ ɔnya ne akatua bere so, nokorɛ mu, na tew wɔ mu.
payroll.keyFunctionsDesc: Tumi titire a Payroll Management Division yɛ.
payroll.dir1Desc: Ɔyɛ aban adwumayɛfoɔ nyinaa akatua bosome biara wɔ ɔman mu. Ɔhwɛ akatua nhyehyɛeɛ, dwumadie, nsɛm ne amanneɛbɔ, akatua twa so adetɔfoɔ, ne amantam akatua so.
payroll.dir2Desc: Ɔhwɛ pɛnhyen akatua dwuma nyinaa so a ɛka pɛnhyen susu, dwumadie, ne bosome akatua ma aban adwumayɛfoɔ a wɔakɔ pɛnhyen.
payroll.kf1Desc: Bosome biara aban adwumayɛfoɔ nyinaa akatua yɛ ne kyɛ.
payroll.kf2Desc: Bosome biara pɛnhyen akatua yɛ ne kyɛ ma aban adwumayɛfoɔ a wɔakɔ pɛnhyen.
payroll.kf3Desc: Akatua twa so yɛ ma ɛtɔ, social security, ne adetɔfoɔ.
payroll.kf4Desc: Tua ka krataa yɛ na de ma a wɔkata so hwɛ ansa na wɔyɛ akatua a ɛdi akyire.
payroll.kf5Desc: Akatua nsɛm, nsusueɛ, ne mpanimfoɔ amanneɛbɔ yɛ.
payroll.kf6: Sika a Wɔtua Bɔso San Gye
payroll.kf6Desc: Sika a wɔtua bɔso ne sika a ɛnyɛ papa hu ne san gye.
payroll.activity1: Hwɛ sɛnea wɔde adwumayɛfoɔ akatua bɛma wɔn
payroll.activity2: Kyerɛ da a wɔbɛtua akatua ne pɛnhyen
payroll.activity3: Bosome biara akatua tua ka krataa yɛ na de ma a wɔkata so hwɛ ansa na wɔyɛ akatua a ɛdi akyire
payroll.activity4: Yɛ akatua twa so ma adetɔfoɔ
payroll.activity5: Gye sika a wɔtua bɔso ne sika a ɛnyɛ papa san firi aban adwumayɛfoɔ hɔ

audit.heroDesc: Yɛhwehwɛ mu na yɛhwɛ asiane nhyehyɛeɛ ne hwɛsoɔ wɔ CAGD dwumadie mu.
audit.purposeDesc: Nkyekyɛmu no na ɛhwɛ nhwehwɛmu dwuma ne adesua dwumadie wɔ CAGD mu. Wɔhyɛɛ Internal Audit Unit aseɛ sɛnea Internal Audit Agency Act, 2003 (Act 658) ne Public Financial Management Act, 2016 (Act 921) kyerɛ. Nkyekyɛmu no de nhwehwɛmu a ɔdi ne ho so ma Management ne Audit Committee wɔ dwumadie ne hwɛsoɔ a wɔde hwɛ asiane so mu.
audit.legalDesc: Nkyekyɛmu no yɛ dwuma wɔ mmara nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛwɔ den a ɛma no tumi ase.
audit.legalCharter: Mmara kɛseɛ a ɛhwɛ Nkyekyɛmu no dwuma so wɔ Internal Audit Charter mu a ɛkyerɛ botaeɛ, nhyehyɛeɛ, tumi ne management dwuma.
audit.orgDesc: Tia nhyehyɛeɛ mfonini no na hwɛ mu yie
audit.directoratesDesc: Tia nkyerɛwsofoɔ ofisi biara so na hwɛ ne nkyekyɛmu ne dwuma mu.
audit.quote: Ahwɛyie ne nokorɛdie — aban sika gyinabie afaafa mmienu.
audit.keyFunctionsDesc: Tumi titire a Audit & Investigation Division yɛ.
audit.law1Desc: Ɛhyɛ nhwehwɛmu dwuma aseɛ wɔ aban ahyehyɛdeɛ nyinaa mu.
audit.law2Desc: Ɛyɛ nhwehwɛmu ne adesua nhyehyɛeɛ foforɔ na ɛma no tumi.
audit.law3Desc: Ɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛeɛ, botaeɛ, tumi ne management dwuma wɔ nhwehwɛmu mu.
audit.dir1Desc: Ɔhwehwɛ adwumayɛfoɔ ne pɛnhyenfoɔ akatua nhyehyɛeɛ mu sɛ nneɛma bi ntɔ yie, adwumayɛfoɔ korɔno, akatua a ɛnyɛ papa, na wɔdi akatua mmara so.
audit.dir2Desc: Ɔhwɛ sika amanneɛbɔ mu na ɔhwɛ sɛ nhwehwɛmu nsɛm di dwuma sɛnea sika ho nokorɛdie ne gyinabie bɛba CAGD dwumadie mu.
audit.dir3Desc: Ɔhwehwɛ nhyehyɛeɛ, IT nhyehyɛeɛ mu, na ɔhwehwɛ sika ho nneɛma a ɛntɔ yie, korɔno, ne nsɛm a ɛhwehwɛ nhwehwɛmu mu.
audit.kf1Desc: Dwumadie, hwɛsoɔ, ne asiane nhyehyɛeɛ nhwehwɛmu a ɔdi ne ho so.
audit.kf2Desc: Korɔno dwumadie a ɛka adwumayɛfoɔ korɔno ne akatua a ɛnyɛ papa hu ne si kwan.
audit.kf3Desc: Aban akatua ne pɛnhyen nhyehyɛeɛ nhwehwɛmu soronko.
audit.kf4Desc: Sika amanneɛbɔ hwɛ mu na hwɛ sɛ akontaa nhyehyɛeɛ di so.
audit.kf5Desc: IT nhyehyɛeɛ ne intanɛt ahotɔ hwɛsoɔ nhwehwɛmu.
audit.kf6Desc: Sika ho nneɛma a ɛntɔ yie ne korɔno a wɔsusuw ho nhwehwɛmu.
